decision.observation: The goose stands right of the gate facing it; the latch handle (metal bar with curled end) protrudes on the gate's top rail near the right post at ~(0.58, 0.34), about 160px above/right of the beak at ~(0.52, 0.56). Pointer is at ~(0.4, 0.68).
decision.hypothesis: The goose must first step directly under the latch handle so the beak can reach it; then a grab press will grip the bar, and a follow-up walk click will drag it open.
decision.memory: Grab persists after button release (boot behavior), so grab-then-walk should drag the latch.
